raw_segments.text: He lighted the candle and looked at the room more carefully.
It was a room so low-pitched that S. Vidrigaylov could only just stand up in it.
The bed, which was very dirty, and the plain-stained chair and table almost filled it up.
The walls looked as though they were made of planks, covered with shabby paper, so torn
and dusty that the pattern was indistinguishable, though the general color yellow could still
One of the walls was cut short by the sloping ceiling.
Though the room was not an attic, but just under the stairs.
